answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The nadir is the serial tenure, the island the custody window that must elapse, and the glacier the standing released at the end of it; the nadir is personal, the island is not skippable, and the glacier cannot be inherited by a sibling.
